portal_stopping.zh_cn: 正在切换或关闭网页服务

portal_failed.zh_cn: 无线传输服务操作失败

portal_scan_wifi.en_us: Scan to join the device hotspot

portal_scan_web.en_us: Scan to open the web dashboard

portal_mode_ap_pending.zh_cn: 设备热点（等待服务就绪）

portal_mode_lan_pending.zh_cn: Wi-Fi 局域网（等待服务就绪）

portal_connect_hint.zh_cn: 连接 Wi-Fi 后，网页服务会自动开启；也可以手动开启设备热点。
portal_connect_hint.en_us: Connect to Wi-Fi to start the web service automatically, or start the device hotspot.

portal_username_hint.zh_cn: 用户名须为 3–32 个字符，只能使用英文字母、数字、下划线、点和连字符。
portal_username_hint.en_us: Use 3–32 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens.

portal_password_hint.zh_cn: 密码须为 8–64 个 UTF-8 字节；中文等字符通常占多个字节。
portal_password_hint.en_us: Use 8–64 UTF-8 bytes. Non-ASCII characters may use multiple bytes.

portal_password_mismatch.zh_cn: 两次输入的密码不一致，请重新确认。
portal_password_mismatch.en_us: The passwords do not match. Enter the confirmation again.

portal_password_private.zh_cn: 已保存的账户密码无法查看。
portal_password_private.en_us: Saved account passwords cannot be viewed.

portal_delete_confirm.zh_cn: 删除后，此账户将无法登录网页，现有登录也会失效。
portal_delete_confirm.en_us: Deleting this account prevents future sign-in and ends its current sessions.

portal_delete_last.zh_cn: 这是最后一个账户。删除后，必须在设备上重新开启初始化，再到网页创建首个账户。
portal_delete_last.en_us: This is the last account. After deletion, you must enable setup on this device again, then create the first account in the browser.

portal_setup_hint.zh_cn: 尚无网页账户。请在设备上开启初始化，再打开传输网页，使用一次性初始化码创建首个账户。
portal_setup_hint.en_us: No web accounts exist. Enable setup here, then open the transfer website and use the one-time code to create the first account.

portal_setup_open_hint.zh_cn: 在传输网页输入下方初始化码，创建第一个账户。
portal_setup_open_hint.en_us: Enter the setup code below on the transfer website to create the first account.

portal_setup_cancel.zh_cn: 取消初始化并隐藏代码

portal_setup_cancelled.zh_cn: 初始化已取消，原初始化码已失效。
portal_setup_cancelled.en_us: Setup cancelled. The previous code is no longer valid.

portal_setup_required.zh_cn: 请先在设备上开启初始化，并在网页创建首个账户。
portal_setup_required.en_us: Enable setup on the device and create the first account in the browser.

portal_auth_loading.zh_cn: 账户服务尚未就绪，请稍候。
portal_auth_loading.en_us: The account service is not ready yet. Please wait.

portal_auth_busy.zh_cn: 正在处理账户操作，请稍候。

portal_auth_invalid.zh_cn: 账户信息无效，请检查用户名和密码。
portal_auth_invalid.en_us: Invalid account details. Check the username and password.

portal_auth_unavailable.zh_cn: 账户服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
portal_auth_unavailable.en_us: The account service is unavailable. Try again later.

portal_auth_corrupt.zh_cn: 账户存储已损坏。需要在设备上恢复出厂设置后重新初始化。
portal_auth_corrupt.en_us: The account store is damaged. A device factory reset is required before setting up accounts again.

portal_auth_storage.zh_cn: 账户存储操作失败，请重启设备后重试。
portal_auth_storage.en_us: The account storage operation failed. Restart the device and try again.

portal_auth_crypto.zh_cn: 账户安全处理失败，请重试。
portal_auth_crypto.en_us: Account security processing failed. Try again.

portal_auth_exists.zh_cn: 此用户名已存在，请使用其他用户名。
portal_auth_exists.en_us: This username already exists. Choose another username.

portal_auth_limit.zh_cn: 最多保存五个账户。请先删除一个账户再添加。
portal_auth_limit.en_us: Up to five accounts are allowed. Delete an account before adding another.

portal_auth_missing.zh_cn: 该账户已不存在，账户列表已更新。
portal_auth_missing.en_us: This account no longer exists. The account list has been refreshed.

portal_auth_rate.zh_cn: 操作过于频繁，请稍后重试。
portal_auth_rate.en_us: Too many attempts. Try again later.

portal_result_unavailable.zh_cn: 无法取得上次操作结果，请检查当前账户列表。
portal_result_unavailable.en_us: The previous operation result is unavailable. Check the current account list.
